text: I bought a subscription last night and it's still not applied. Is this a bug? I got the 24-hour discounted price and I would prefer not to lose it.
author: Magdalena Kalenská
developer_reply: Hello! This is Routinery.💛 We are so deeply sorry that your subscription benefit was not immediately applied after payment. This is an unacceptable bug that violates your trust. To resolve this, please send your Google Play receipt (GPA number) or transaction ID to hello@routinery.app. We are treating this as our top priority.
